items.title: 56799_Red Norvo oral history interview
items.q: I'm going out to California... came back and got Eve, we went out there... we became friends and Eve was crazy about Helen

ctx.x: And the younger ones were quite young. The baby was six months and Portia's a couple years older and Mark was in first grade, I believe. We used to go up to Mildred's farm. Lot of people say, say to Eve, Aren't you -- how do you feel about that? She said, 'Well I'm sure if Red wanted to be married to Mildred he would.'
